```yaml
name: Promote RC to Stable Release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'Release Candidate tag (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Validate RC tag and compute stable tag
        id: validate
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          echo "RC tag: $RC_TAG"
          
          # Extract version parts
          if [[ ! "$RC_TAG" =~ ^v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)-rc([0-9]+)$ ]]; then
            echo "Invalid RC tag format. Must be vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH-rcNUM"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          MAJOR="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
          MINOR="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
          PATCH="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
          RC_NUM="${BASH_REMATCH[4]}"
          
          STABLE_TAG="v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.${PATCH}"
          echo "Stable tag will be: $STABLE_TAG"
          
          # Check if RC tag exists
          if ! git rev-parse "$RC_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "RC tag $RC_TAG does not exist"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check if stable tag already exists
          if git rev-parse "$STABLE_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Stable tag $STABLE_TAG already exists"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Get commit SHA
          COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse "$RC_TAG")
          echo "Commit SHA: $COMMIT_SHA"
          
          # Validate that RC release exists on GitHub
          RC_RELEASE_EXISTS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tags/$RC_TAG")
          if [ "$RC_RELEASE_EXISTS" != "200" ]; then
            echo "RC release $RC_TAG does not exist on GitHub"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "stable_tag=$STABLE_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "commit_sha=$COMMIT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  promote:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Create stable git tag
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git tag "${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}" "${{ needs.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}"
          git push origin "${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"

      - name: Retag Docker images
        run: |
          # Retag grafana/beyla
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag grafana/beyla:${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }} \
            grafana/beyla:${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}
          
          # Retag grafana/beyla-k8s-cache
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }} \
            grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}

      - name: Copy release assets
        run: |
          # Get release ID for RC
          RC_RELEASE_ID=$(curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tags/${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}" | jq -r '.id')
          
          # Get stable release ID or create one
          STABLE_RELEASE_ID=$(curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tags/${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}" | jq -r '.id')
          
          if [ "$STABLE_RELEASE_ID" = "null" ]; then
            # Create stable release
            STABLE_RELEASE_DATA=$(curl -s -X POST "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases" \
              -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              -d '{
                "tag_name": "${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}",
                "target_commitish": "${{ needs.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}",
                "name": "${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}",
                "draft": false,
                "prerelease": false
              }' | jq -r '.id')
            STABLE_RELEASE_ID="$STABLE_RELEASE_DATA"
          fi

      - name: Generate release notes
        run: |
          # Simple release notes generation
          RELEASE_NOTES="# Release Notes\n\nThis is a stable release promoting the validated release candidate ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}.\n\n## Changes\n\n* Promoted from RC ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}\n\n## Assets\n\nBinary assets have been copied from the RC release."

          # Update release with notes
          curl -s -X PATCH "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/${STABLE_RELEASE_ID}" \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -d "{\"body\": \"$RELEASE_NOTES\"}"

      - name: Post-promotion checklist
        run: |
          echo "## Promotion Complete! 🎉"
          echo ""
          echo "Please manually verify and complete the following:"
          echo "1. [ ] Publish Helm chart to Artifact Hub"
          echo "2. [ ] Update technical documentation"
          echo "3. [ ] Announce release in appropriate channels"
          echo ""
          echo "Stable tag created: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          echo "RC tag preserved: ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          echo "Docker images retagged successfully"
```
